title: Be bad for
subtitle: 「對……不好／有害／造成負面影響」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中很自然的替代表達？
description: 「對……不好／有害／造成負面影響」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中很自然的替代表達？

words.note: 最直接、最廣泛的替代表達之一，可指身體、環境、名譽、經濟等受到傷害。
words.example: Too much sunlight can harm your skin.
words.exampleZh: 過多陽光可能傷害皮膚。

exercises.original: Too much sunlight can be bad for your skin.
exercises.zh: 過多陽光可能傷害皮膚。
exercises.upgrade: Too much sunlight can harm your skin.

options.explanation: 最直接表示對皮膚造成傷害。
表示使更明亮，不表示傷害。

exercises.original: Excessive noise can be bad for children's hearing.
exercises.zh: 過度噪音可能傷害兒童聽力。
exercises.upgrade: Excessive noise can harm children's hearing.

exercises.original: The chemical spill was bad for local wildlife.
exercises.zh: 化學物洩漏傷害了當地野生動物。
exercises.upgrade: The chemical spill harmed local wildlife.

options.explanation: 環境傷害語境非常自然。

words.note: 比 harm 更常強調某種可見、實際或持久的損害。
words.example: Salt water can damage electronic equipment.

exercises.original: Salt water can be bad for electronic equipment.
exercises.zh: 鹽水會損壞電子設備。
exercises.upgrade: Salt water can damage electronic equipment.

options.explanation: 實體設備受損，damage 比 harm 更自然。

exercises.original: Constant rumours can be bad for a person's reputation.
exercises.zh: 持續的謠言可能損害一個人的名譽。
exercises.upgrade: Constant rumours can damage a person's reputation.

options.explanation: damage a reputation 是非常常見搭配。

exercises.original: Repeated arguments can be bad for relationships.
exercises.zh: 反覆爭吵可能損害關係。
exercises.upgrade: Repeated arguments can damage relationships.

options.explanation: 關係受到實際損害，很自然。

words.note: 和 be bad for 非常接近，而且更正式、更精確。
words.example: Smoking is harmful to your health.

exercises.original: Smoking is bad for your health.
exercises.zh: 吸煙對健康有害。
exercises.upgrade: Smoking is harmful to your health.

options.explanation: 和 bad for 在健康語境幾乎可直接互換。

exercises.original: This pesticide may be bad for bees.
exercises.zh: 這種殺蟲劑可能對蜜蜂有害。
exercises.upgrade: This pesticide may be harmful to bees.

options.explanation: 環境／生物影響語境非常自然。

exercises.original: Too much screen time can be bad for young children's sleep.
exercises.zh: 過多螢幕時間可能對幼兒睡眠有害。
exercises.upgrade: Too much screen time can be harmful to young children's sleep.

options.explanation: 直接表示對睡眠造成不良影響。

words.note: 正式、書面，表示某事會造成明顯負面影響。
words.example: Chronic stress can be detrimental to mental health.
words.exampleZh: 長期壓力可能對心理健康造成不利影響。

exercises.original: Chronic stress can be bad for mental health.
exercises.zh: 長期壓力可能對心理健康造成不利影響。
exercises.upgrade: Chronic stress can be detrimental to mental health.

options.explanation: 正式地表示造成不利影響。

exercises.original: Poor communication can be bad for teamwork.
exercises.zh: 溝通不良可能對團隊合作造成不利影響。
exercises.upgrade: Poor communication can be detrimental to teamwork.

options.explanation: 正式商業／組織語境自然。

exercises.original: Excessive debt can be bad for long-term economic stability.
exercises.zh: 過度債務可能對長期經濟穩定造成不利影響。
exercises.upgrade: Excessive debt can be detrimental to long-term economic stability.

options.explanation: 正式經濟分析中非常自然。

words.note: 強調某事會帶來實際或長期損害。
words.example: Constant criticism can be damaging to a child's confidence.
words.exampleZh: 持續批評可能損害孩子的自信。

exercises.original: Constant criticism can be bad for a child's confidence.
exercises.zh: 持續批評可能損害孩子的自信。
exercises.upgrade: Constant criticism can be damaging to a child's confidence.

options.explanation: 強調自信受到持續損害。

exercises.original: False accusations can be bad for someone's career.
exercises.zh: 虛假指控可能損害一個人的事業。
exercises.upgrade: False accusations can be damaging to someone's career.

options.explanation: 事業受損的語感非常自然。

exercises.original: Repeated delays are bad for customer trust.
exercises.zh: 反覆延誤會損害顧客信任。
exercises.upgrade: Repeated delays are damaging to customer trust.

options.explanation: 表示信任逐漸受到損害。

words.note: 非常通用、中性，適合多數正式和日常語境。
words.example: Lack of sleep can have a negative effect on concentration.
words.exampleZh: 睡眠不足會對專注力產生負面影響。

exercises.original: Lack of sleep is bad for concentration.
exercises.zh: 睡眠不足會對專注力產生負面影響。
exercises.upgrade: Lack of sleep has a negative effect on concentration.

options.explanation: 中性、通用地表示負面影響。

exercises.original: Long commutes can be bad for work-life balance.
exercises.zh: 長途通勤會對工作與生活平衡產生負面影響。
exercises.upgrade: Long commutes can have a negative effect on work-life balance.

exercises.original: Excessive heat can be bad for productivity.
exercises.zh: 過度高溫會對生產力產生負面影響。
exercises.upgrade: Excessive heat can have a negative effect on productivity.

words.note: 較正式，是 have a negative effect on 的正式版本。
words.example: The chemicals may have an adverse effect on aquatic life.
words.exampleZh: 這些化學物質可能對水生生物造成不良影響。

exercises.original: The chemicals may be bad for aquatic life.
exercises.zh: 這些化學物質可能對水生生物造成不良影響。
exercises.upgrade: The chemicals may have an adverse effect on aquatic life.

options.explanation: 正式環境報告語境很自然。

exercises.original: Some medications can be bad for liver function.
exercises.zh: 部分藥物可能對肝功能造成不良影響。
exercises.upgrade: Some medications can have an adverse effect on liver function.

exercises.original: The policy change could be bad for small exporters.
exercises.zh: 政策改變可能對小型出口商造成不良影響。
exercises.upgrade: The policy change could have an adverse effect on small exporters.

words.meaning: 負面影響；對……產生不良影響
words.note: 簡潔、正式，適合研究、報告、一般分析。
words.example: Noise can negatively affect sleep quality.
words.exampleZh: 噪音會對睡眠質素產生負面影響。

exercises.original: Noise can be bad for sleep quality.
exercises.zh: 噪音會對睡眠質素產生負面影響。
exercises.upgrade: Noise can negatively affect sleep quality.

options.explanation: 表示穩定，不是負面影響。

exercises.original: Poor lighting can be bad for employee performance.
exercises.zh: 照明不足可能對員工表現產生負面影響。
exercises.upgrade: Poor lighting can negatively affect employee performance.

exercises.original: Frequent interruptions can be bad for productivity.
exercises.zh: 頻繁打斷會對生產力產生負面影響。
exercises.upgrade: Frequent interruptions can negatively affect productivity.

words.note: 比 negatively affect 更正式。
words.example: Poor ventilation may adversely affect indoor air quality.
words.exampleZh: 通風不足可能對室內空氣質素造成不利影響。

exercises.original: Poor ventilation can be bad for indoor air quality.
exercises.zh: 通風不足可能對室內空氣質素造成不利影響。
exercises.upgrade: Poor ventilation can adversely affect indoor air quality.

exercises.original: Severe weather may be bad for crop yields.
exercises.zh: 惡劣天氣可能對農作物產量造成不利影響。
exercises.upgrade: Severe weather may adversely affect crop yields.

exercises.original: The delay could be bad for the project's finances.
exercises.zh: 延誤可能對項目的財務狀況造成不利影響。
exercises.upgrade: The delay could adversely affect the project's finances.

words.note: 表示某事令能力、功能、健康或性能下降。
words.example: Alcohol can impair your ability to drive safely.
words.exampleZh: 酒精會削弱你安全駕駛的能力。

exercises.original: Alcohol can be bad for your ability to drive safely.
exercises.zh: 酒精會削弱你安全駕駛的能力。
exercises.upgrade: Alcohol can impair your ability to drive safely.

options.explanation: 表示能力／功能下降，最精確。

exercises.original: Fatigue can be bad for judgment.
exercises.zh: 疲勞會削弱判斷力。
exercises.upgrade: Fatigue can impair judgment.

options.explanation: impair judgment 是固定自然搭配。
表示澄清，不是增強判斷力。

exercises.original: The injury was bad for his mobility.
exercises.zh: 這次受傷削弱了他的活動能力。
exercises.upgrade: The injury impaired his mobility.

words.note: 表示某事慢慢削弱信心、權威、穩定性、努力或關係。
words.exampleZh: 反覆失敗可能削弱信心。

exercises.original: Repeated failures can be bad for confidence.
exercises.zh: 反覆失敗可能削弱信心。
exercises.upgrade: Repeated failures can undermine confidence.

exercises.original: Lack of transparency is bad for public trust.
exercises.zh: 缺乏透明度會削弱公眾信任。
exercises.upgrade: Lack of transparency undermines public trust.

exercises.original: Constant rule changes can be bad for staff morale.
exercises.zh: 不斷改變規則可能削弱員工士氣。
exercises.upgrade: Constant rule changes can undermine staff morale.

words.note: 較口語，可指身體疼痛，也可指生意、名譽、機會、表現。
words.example: Higher costs could hurt small businesses.
words.exampleZh: 成本上升可能對小型企業不利。

exercises.original: Higher costs could be bad for small businesses.
exercises.zh: 成本上升可能對小型企業不利。
exercises.upgrade: Higher costs could hurt small businesses.

options.explanation: 口語而自然地表示對生意造成損害。

exercises.original: The bad review was bad for the restaurant's reputation.
exercises.zh: 這篇負面評論損害了餐廳聲譽。
exercises.upgrade: The bad review hurt the restaurant's reputation.

options.explanation: 較口語地表達名譽受到損害。

exercises.original: A long delay could be bad for our chances of winning the contract.
exercises.zh: 長時間延誤可能損害我們贏得合約的機會。
exercises.upgrade: A long delay could hurt our chances of winning the contract.

options.explanation: hurt someone's chances 是自然搭配。

words.note: harm 的常見固定表達，語氣自然且稍正式。
words.example: The waste could do serious harm to marine life.
words.exampleZh: 這些廢物可能對海洋生物造成嚴重傷害。

exercises.original: The waste could be bad for marine life.
exercises.zh: 這些廢物可能對海洋生物造成傷害。
exercises.upgrade: The waste could do harm to marine life.

options.explanation: 固定自然表達，和 harm 非常接近。

exercises.original: Spreading false information can be bad for public confidence.
exercises.zh: 散播虛假資訊可能對公眾信心造成傷害。
exercises.upgrade: Spreading false information can do harm to public confidence.

options.explanation: 表示造成實際負面影響。

exercises.original: The invasive species may be bad for the local ecosystem.
exercises.zh: 這種入侵物種可能對本地生態系統造成傷害。
exercises.upgrade: The invasive species may do harm to the local ecosystem.

words.note: 常見表達，表示某種持續壓力、工作、疾病或困難逐漸造成傷害。
words.example: Long working hours can take a toll on your health.
words.exampleZh: 長時間工作會逐漸損害健康。

exercises.original: Long working hours can be bad for your health over time.
exercises.zh: 長時間工作會隨時間逐漸損害健康。
exercises.upgrade: Long working hours can take a toll on your health over time.

options.explanation: 強調長期累積的消耗與損害。

exercises.original: Months of uncertainty were bad for the team's morale.
exercises.zh: 數月的不確定性逐漸消耗了團隊士氣。
exercises.upgrade: Months of uncertainty took a toll on the team's morale.

options.explanation: 長時間累積影響是關鍵。

exercises.original: The long illness was bad for the family's finances.
exercises.zh: 長期疾病逐漸對家庭財政造成沉重負擔。
exercises.upgrade: The long illness took a toll on the family's finances.

options.explanation: 強調長期逐漸造成財務損害。

falseSynonyms.zh: 困難不等於有害 某件事可以 difficult，但不一定造成損害。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The exam was difficult for him. The lack of sleep was bad for his concentration.

falseSynonyms.zh: 令人不舒服不等於有害 unpleasant 描述感受；harmful 描述實際傷害。
令人煩厭不等於損害 某件事 annoying 並不代表它會造成 harm。
影響不一定是負面 affect 本身是中性的。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The weather affected attendance. The pollution negatively affected health.

falseSynonyms.zh: 減少不一定等於有害 reduce 只表示數量下降；是否 harmful 要看語境。
摧毀通常比「不好」強太多 destroy 表示嚴重甚至完全破壞，不能隨便代替 be bad for。
只適合健康語境 unhealthy 對健康很自然，但不能廣泛替代：
falseSynonyms.point: bad for business bad for trust bad for the environment

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性陷阱 - harm = 動詞／名詞 - harmful = 形容詞 - harmfully = 副詞（較少用）
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Smoking harms your health. Smoking is harmful to your health.
